turning.title: THE TURNING POINT
turning.subtitle: The rise of the Egyptian Baccalaureate
turning.intro: Law No. 169 of 2025 introduced the Egyptian Baccalaureate as an alternative track to Thanaweya Amma.

facts.label: Law No. 169 of 2025
facts.text: Introduced the Egyptian Baccalaureate as an alternative track to Thanaweya Amma.

facts.label: Starting year
facts.text: The system starts in the 2025–2026 academic year.

facts.label: First-year secondary
facts.text: Optional for first-year secondary students, alongside the traditional system.

how.title: HOW IT WORKS
how.subtitle: The student journey, from Grade 1 to Grade 3 secondary
how.intro: The Egyptian Baccalaureate, step by step.

subjects.title: Study Subjects
subjects.coreTitle: Grade 2 · Core subjects for all tracks
subjects.tracksText: Each track has ONE specialization subject, chosen in Grade 2.
subjects.grade3Title: Grade 3 · Two advanced specialization subjects per track
subjects.religionText: Not counted in the total, but requires at least 70% to pass.

items.label: Per subject
items.text: Each subject is graded out of 100.

items.label: Final total
items.text: The final total is out of 600.

items.label: Best attempt counts
items.text: The highest score in each subject across all attempts counts.

items.label: From 2026/2027
items.text: Exams are 50% multiple choice and 50% essay questions.

items.label: To sit the exam
items.text: To sit the first-chance exam, a student must complete 60% of weekly and monthly assessments for each subject.

exams.title: Examination Opportunities
exams.years: Students may attempt exams across four academic years.
exams.trackChange: Grade 3 students may change track if they study the specialization subject of the new track.

how.note: Information based on Ministry of Education decisions as of November 2026. Details may be updated.

cards.quote: I don't just want to pass. I want to understand why I'm learning, and what I can do with what I learn.
cards.alt: Illustrative scene of a secondary school student in a dim classroom

cards.quote: Every parent wants to see their children have real chances to choose their future.
cards.alt: Illustrative scene of a mother at a kitchen table with a cup of tea

cards.quote: Education isn't just grades and exams. Real education is when a student knows how to think, analyze and create.
cards.alt: Illustrative scene of a teacher standing in front of a chalkboard
